        - "Rebinding changed one profile file and one binding coordinate; add/remove/disable file counts were recorded."

        grouping: "Owner metadata can group declarations, but no person was asked to find or classify them."
        ownership: "Measured source contains owner authority/path; validation and human discoverability were not measured."
        binding: "Central profile edits are localized; the baseline did not model multiple implementations of the same logical module."

      - "Theia: preserve deterministic snapshot membership; keep scopes and lifecycle in the host."
      - "Equinox: distinguish requirements from activation/start levels; reject mutable refresh semantics in Core."
      - "Effect: typed requires/provides/errors are informative; executable layers and runtime scopes are not Core."
      - "Avvio: boot, failure, close order, timeouts, and rollback belong to the host."
      - "T2 follow-up: inherited reads remain accepted under ADR-0007; own-data-only behavior is an optional successor."
    rejected_imports: "Framework containers, Symbols as identity, mutable registries, registration-order semantics, dynamic imports, classloader isolation, executable layers, lifecycle state, and timeout-as-cancellation."
